login_using_phone_pin: Login using your registered phone number and PIN
hero_description: MedJarvis connects patients, doctors, hospitals, ambulances, and healthcare professionals through one intelligent platform powered by AI, IoT, and secure digital health services.
feature_description: MedJarvis brings together AI, connected devices, secure digital health records and healthcare professionals into one unified ecosystem that helps people receive better care, faster decisions and a smoother healthcare experience.
ai_health_intelligence_desc: AI analyzes health information, supports early detection, and assists healthcare professionals with smarter clinical insights.
connected_devices_desc: Secure IoT connectivity allows wearable devices and healthcare systems to share important health information in real time.
secure_digital_identity_desc: QR-based digital health identity enables fast access to verified medical information while maintaining privacy and security.
smart_monitoring_desc: Continuous health monitoring, AI-powered alerts and intelligent insights help healthcare providers make faster decisions.
workflow_description: From health monitoring to AI-powered insights and secure healthcare services, MedJarvis simplifies every step of the patient journey.
monitor_desc: Wearable devices and healthcare data continuously monitor important health parameters.
analyze_desc: AI evaluates health information and detects possible risks using intelligent analysis.
connect_desc: Doctors, caregivers and hospitals receive important information instantly.
care_desc: Faster response, smarter treatment and better healthcare experiences for everyone.
roles_description: MedJarvis connects every stakeholder in the healthcare ecosystem through one secure and intelligent platform.
patients_role_desc: Manage medical records, monitor health, access AI assistance and securely share health information whenever needed.
doctors_role_desc: Review patient history, receive AI-powered insights, manage appointments and provide better clinical decisions.
health_workers_role_desc: Support rural healthcare through home visits, offline patient management and digital healthcare tools.
ambulance_role_desc: Receive emergency alerts, navigate efficiently and access essential patient information during emergencies.
hospitals_role_desc: Coordinate departments, manage patient flow and monitor healthcare resources from one platform.
administrators_role_desc: Monitor the platform, manage users, maintain security and oversee healthcare operations efficiently.
cta_description: Join MedJarvis to access AI-powered healthcare, secure digital health identity, connected wearable devices, multilingual assistance and seamless collaboration between patients, doctors, hospitals and emergency responders.
footer_brand_desc: MedJarvis is an AI-powered healthcare platform connecting patients, doctors, hospitals, health workers and emergency services through one secure digital ecosystem.
built_with_love: Built with ❤️ for accessible and intelligent healthcare.
